meta.title: Reassign Line Item: refused for a user without the Procurement Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and as a Procurement Manager in the same Growth tenant
Locate and execute Reassign Line Item on a PR line item
Verify the non-manager is refused or the action is absent while the Procurement Manager can complete it
Verify or change the tenant's RBAC configuration and Growth plan access
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and as a Procurement Manager in the same Growth tenant; Locate and execute Reassign Line Item on a PR line item; Verify the non-manager is refused or the action is absent while the Procurement Manager can complete it; Verify or change the tenant's RBAC configuration and Growth plan access

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area where the PR line item would be reassigned.

args.need: sign in as the non-Procurement Manager and then as the Procurement Manager in the same tenant, attempt Reassign Line Item on a PR line item, and record whether the action is refused or available for each role

steps.note: Role-specific sessions and the Reassign Line Item permission outcome are not expressible by catalog steps.
Confirm the session remains free of crashes or server errors after the tester's role comparison.
